notes.subject: מנחמי עמל
notes.rationale: 'comforters of trouble/toil': taken as 'troublesome comforters' (KJV) or 'comforters of the afflicted one' (i.e. of Job); I follow the first.

notes.subject: to the friends
notes.rationale: 'ye all' — direct address to the three comforters.

notes.subject: nimasara bɔbaw
notes.rationale: Hebrew names the comforters with a noun of troubled toil; Bambara renders the scorn as 'wretched comforters'.

translation: N mɛn nin kuma caman ya; aw bɛɛ ye nimasara bɔbaw ye.
